Task Succeeded. Result: ## Growth-Analyst Findings

### 1. Private Metrics — Unavailable & Collection Methods

| Metric | Status | Collection Method (Supplier Sample Stage) |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------|
| Price | **unavailable** | Record wholesale/unit cost from supplier quote; check competitor public price bands via manual shelf scan |
| Margin | **unavailable** | Compute as (planned retail price − landed unit cost) ÷ planned retail price after supplier confirms COGS + shipping + duties |
| Competitor pricing | **unavailable** | Manual 10-SKU shelf scan on Amazon/Target/Walgreens for "adult eye patch with tie band" — record visible prices |
| CAC proxy | **unavailable** | Run a no-ad test: share a landing page or product link to 3 relevant Facebook groups. Track inquiries ÷ impressions as a free CAC-proxy signal |
| Conversion intent | **unavailable** | Manual willingness-to-pay check: ask 10 target users "Would you buy this at $X?" Count yes/total. Also ask purchase-intent questions in group posts |

### 2. Signal from 4.4 Rating / 26 Ratings

- **What it provides**: A positive central tendency. 4.4 out of 5 is above average for beauty/medical accessories, suggesting early buyers found the product satisfactory.
- **Confidence**: **Low-to-Medium**. 26 ratings is a thin sample — margin of error is wide (approximate 95% CI: ~3.8–4.9). A single batch of 5-star or 1-2 star reviews could shift the mean meaningfully.
- **Limitations**: No distribution (all 5-star vs polarized?), no review text to confirm what drove ratings, no known verified purchase rate, no returns data. This is a public signal, not a quality certificate.

### 3. Lightweight Validation Test (No Ad Spend)

**"10-User Physical Sample + Interview" Test** (7 days)
- Give or loan the product to 10 people who fit the target (post-surgery, eye patching, light sensitivity).
- After 3–5 days of use, collect: fit satisfaction, comfort duration, band tension issues, washing durability, willingness to buy at intended price, one-word objection.
- **Decision rule**: If ≥7/10 report "would buy" and no more than 2 cite the same unresolved objection → Go to pre-launch test. Otherwise → Pivot (band design, size, or price).

### 4. Signals for Next Loop

| Signal | Target | Source |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Purchase intent yes-rate | ≥7/10 | User interview |
| Top objection repeat rate | ≤2/10 | User interview |
| Price acceptance range | ≥6/10 at target price | Willingness-to-pay check |
| Comment/save ratio on organic post | ≥5% save rate | Group post engagement |

Task Succeeded. Result: ## asset-studio: Eye Patch Black Adult with Tie Band (6 Per Pack)

### 1. Listing Headline Options

**Option A (Function-First)**
> Sleep Mask for Adults – Adjustable Tie Band, Light-Blocking Eye Cover, 6-Pack
- `ready_public_insight`: "Sleep mask", "adjustable tie band", "6-pack" (directly from title/product category)
- `needs_product_spec`: "light-blocking" — degree unconfirmed; use placeholder phrasing

**Option B (Use-Case Anchored)**
> Travel & Nap Eye Patches for Men & Women – 6-Pack with Secure Tie Closure
- `ready_public_insight`: "travel & nap" (inferred from product category "All Beauty" + tie-band design), "6-pack", "tie closure"
- `needs_product_spec`: "secure" — fit/band elasticity unconfirmed

**Option C (Value-Stack)**
> Adult Eye Cover – 6 Count, Soft [material_to_confirm] Fabric, One-Size-Fits-All Tie Band
- `ready_public_insight`: "adult", "6 count", "tie band", "one-size-fits-all" (tie band adjusts by definition)
- `needs_product_spec`: "[material_to_confirm]" — placeholder required; cannot name fabric

### 2. Short-Video / Social Content Hooks (15-60 sec)

**Hook A: Travel Utility**
> "3 reasons your hotel room needs this $X [price to confirm] eye mask before your next flight."
- `ready_public_insight`: hotel/travel context fits tie-band mask design
- `needs_product_spec`: price; light-blocking effectiveness
- `draft_only`: script claim about "3 reasons" must not invent benefits

**Hook B: Tie-Band Differentiator**
> "Elastic straps dig into your hair? This tie-band design fixes that."
- `ready_public_insight`: elastic-strap pain point is a known category issue
- `needs_product_spec`: tie-band material, adjustability range
- `do_not_use_until_verified`: cannot claim "fixes that" without user test — rephrase as "may be gentler on hair"

### 3. Specs Needed From Supplier

| Spec | Why needed |
|-------|-----------|
| `[material_to_confirm]` | Fabric type (cotton, polyester, silk, foam) — drives comfort & breathability claims |
| `[dimensions_to_confirm]` | Width, height, strap length — buyers need to know if it fits adult/child |
| `[light_blocking_to_confirm]` | Any light-blocking feature (contoured cup, flat, lined) — core product promise |
| `[care_instructions_to_confirm]` | Washable or disposable? |
| `[price_to_confirm]` | Cannot size the offer or value-proposition without price |
| `[packaging_to_confirm]` | Retail-ready or bulk polybag? Impacts gifting / travel copy |

### 4. Claim Readiness

**Publishable Now (ready_public_insight)**
- "6-pack" — observed from title
- "Adult" sizing — observed from title
- "Tie band closure" — observed from title
- "Adjustable fit" (tie band is inherently adjustable)
- "Black color" — observed from title
- Category: sleep/beauty/eye mask — from title + "All Beauty" category

**Needs Supplier Confirmation (needs_product_spec)**
- Material name → insert `[material_to_confirm]`
- Light-blocking degree → use "intended to block light" (soft), not "blocks 90% of light"
- Fit range → "one-size" placeholder until dimensions provided
- Wash/reuse instructions → insert `[care_instructions_to_confirm]`
- Price → insert `[price_to_confirm]`

**Do Not Use Until Verified (do_not_use_until_verified)**
- Hypoallergenic / medical-grade — no evidence
- "Doctor recommended" — no evidence
- "Perfect for migraines" or any therapeutic benefit — no test report
- Specific light-blocking % — no test report
- "Softest fabric ever" — subjective, no product in hand
- "Fully blocks all light" — cannot be confirmed

**Draft Only / Needs Rewrite**
- "Fixes elastic hair damage" → soften to "tie band avoids elastic tension"
- "Ideal for deep sleep" → soften to "designed for rest"

**Bottom line:** The safest angle is **"6-Pack Adult Eye Mask with Adjustable Tie Band"** — stick to what the title confirms, add `[material_to_confirm]` and `[light_blocking_to_confirm]` as soon as the supplier provides those specs.

| EVID-005 | `unavailable` | fixture limitation | n/a | Price, ROI, CTR, CVR, sales volume | No private merchant data whatsoever. |

### 2. Unsafe Claim Types (3+ with required evidence)

| Unsafe Claim | Why Unsafe | Evidence Needed |
|---|---|---|
| "Medical-grade eye patch for post-surgery recovery" | Category "All Beauty" contradicts; no medical claims, certifications, or intended-use statement in product metadata. | Product label/packaging, FDA or CE clearance, intended-use statement from manufacturer. |
| "Proven customer satisfaction / top-rated eye patch" | Only 26 ratings exist — statistically insignificant for a reliability claim. No dimension-level (fit, comfort, efficacy) breakdown. | ≥100 ratings with dimension breakdown; comparative benchmark vs. comparable SKUs. |
| "Durable, reusable, washable" or any material-duration claim | Features list is empty (`features: []`). No material spec, care instructions, or test report. | Product spec sheet, material composition, care instructions, or test report (e.g., wash-cycle count before degradation). |
| "Best price in category" or "affordable alternative" | Price is `unavailable`. Competitor pricing is absent from fixture. | Public competitor prices; own list price. |

### 3. Category Mismatch Risk — HIGH

- "All Beauty" implies cosmetic/anti-aging/wrinkle-reduction use (e.g., silk eye mask, skincare patch).
- "Black adult eye patch with tie band" strongly suggests **medical occlusion** (e.g., amblyopia treatment, post-cataract recovery, eye injury protection).
- **Risk**: Wrong audience lands on page → high bounce, low conversion, negative comments ("this isn't for wrinkles!"). Conversely, medical buyers won't search "All Beauty." The product is invisible to its actual buyers.
- **Recommendation**: Reclassify under **Health & Household > Medical Supplies & Equipment > Eye Patches** or similar. If cosmetic is intentional, the title and description must explicitly state the beauty/cosmetic use case (e.g., "dark circle treatment," "sleep mask").

### 4. Overall Evidence Quality Rating: **LOW**

**Rationale:**
- Product identity (medical vs. cosmetic) is unresolved — this is the single most critical unknown.
- Customer voice: **zero** eye-patch-specific reviews or feedback.
- No description, features, price, or images.
- 26 ratings with no dimension breakdown is insufficient for any launch decision beyond "test very cautiously."

**Decision implication**: At supplier_sample stage, this evidence supports **HOLD** — do not proceed to pre_launch_test until product category, intended use, and basic spec/imagery are resolved.

### 诊断结果

- **上新阶段**：`supplier_sample`（供应商样品阶段）
- **推荐决策**：**Pivot（转向）**
- **依据**：产品元数据极度稀疏——无描述、无功能列表、无价格、无客户评价。但产品概念本身（带系带的黑色眼罩，6只装）并非不可行。4.4/26条评分表明早期用户基本满意。核心问题是**类别错位**——产品归入"All Beauty"类别，但从标题推断的实际使用场景是医疗/术后恢复/睡眠遮光，而非美容护肤品。建议重新归类至健康与家居/眼部护理类别。

### 关键发现

1. **类别错位风险（高）**：美容类目会吸引错误受众（如寻找去皱眼贴的用户），而真正需要术后眼罩/遮光眼贴的买家不会在美容类目搜索。

### 下一轮测试

**7天样品实测**：招募5-10名目标用户（术后恢复者、光敏感睡眠者、视障遮光使用者）过夜试用样品，收集贴合度、舒适度、遮光效果、系带压力反馈。判定规则：≥7/10愿意购买且≤2/10提出同一未解决问题 → 进入预发布测试。

同时向供应商索取：产品描述、材料成分、尺寸、护理说明、定价和预期用途声明。
